overview_description.description: Arva AI (LinkedIn) makes onboarding onto a bank/fintech as a business 100x faster and significantly cheaper. We've built a highly compliant AI agent that instantly handles all low/medium risk manual KYB work in real-time as a customer is onboarding, cutting reviews to seconds and ops spend by 80%.

about_short_description.short_description: Arva AI provides AI agents for instant global KYB onboarding for banks and fintech companies

product.name: AI Enabled Business Verification
product.description: A suite of AI checks for business verification that enriches data and detects fraud to support compliance and risk mitigation.

product.name: Deep Online Due Diligence
product.description: AI agents analyze online data sources to enrich KYB checks, identify fraudsters, and detect adverse media with minimal customer input.

product.name: Document Intelligence
product.description: Vision AI detects document fraud and extracts data from various business documents to simplify processing and verification.

product.name: Real-time Customer Communication
product.description: A system that interacts with customers during onboarding to reduce information requests and correct mismatched data in real time.

product.name: Data Enrichment
product.description: Enriches business verification with incorporation and ownership data from over 150 countries to support global onboarding.

product.name: Case Management and Orchestration
product.description: Tools to consolidate compliance cases, orchestrate workflows, and integrate KYC processes for streamlined AML and KYB operations.
